risk: Invalid master data propagates to transactions
exception_handling: Investigate and submit a corrected request
limitation: Demo rules do not verify legal identity

control_activity: Require approver role and separation from requester and validator
exception_handling: Block approval and use a separate approver

objective: Record independent review of verification reference
control_activity: Require a reference and review the proposal
limitation: Reference contents are fictional and not externally verified

risk: Old approval overwrites a newer master
control_activity: Revalidate uniqueness and compare expected version before applying
evidence: requests and APPLY before-after audit event
exception_handling: Block stale request and require a new proposal

frequency: After each demo sync and at final review
control_activity: Run field-level ERP reconciliation and retry failed sync
exception_handling: Keep mismatch visible until successful retry
limitation: ERP is a local snapshot with no network connector

risk: Issue is closed without successful remediation
objective: Require traceable resolution and independent retest
control_activity: Check applied replacement and current master and ERP agreement
exception_handling: Keep issue open until retest succeeds
limitation: Covers validation issues rather than all operational incidents

objective: Retain original inputs and successful workflow history
control_activity: Store original proposals and append workflow events
limitation: Database owner can bypass triggers and retention is not enforced
